name: Funkin' Rack
author: Skarmuse
description: Friday Night Funkin' characters that live in your rack. Import any mod's spritesheets, drive the opponent from your patch, and play the answer back with a gamepad, the computer keyboard or MIDI.

modules.name: Funkin Opponent
modules.description: A Friday Night Funkin' character that stands in your rack and sings whatever four gates tell it to. Sends what it sang back out as a chart.

modules.name: Funkin Player
modules.description: The other half of the duel: notes come down a road and you play them back with a gamepad, the computer keyboard, MIDI or four gates. What you hit comes out as gates.

modules.name: Funkin Dancer
modules.description: The character in the background: no arrows, just a character who dances on the beat and hands the beat back out as a trigger, a bar marker and a falling envelope.
